shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright monolithic surface
curved/arcing linear motif on the body of the stone
schematic zoomorphic or symbolic sign rendered as an outline in shallow relief
justification: Both surfaces show sparse, shallow low-relief motifs in schematic outline on the broad face of a large upright block, and each includes an arcing linear element crossing the surface. But A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a head and a torso covered by concentric rings, discs, a curved belt-like band and hoop motifs, whereas B shows a single isolated animal-like creature with an angular arched body and head in profile — no shared specific motif or relationship between motifs.
